stable.notes: The speaker sheet now tells you how much of a meeting carries a name. The header showed only segments and voices, and the only coverage signal was a boolean that goes false when NOTHING was identified - so a meeting where 295 of 299 chunks matched nobody looked normally attributed. It counts segments whose row is actually shown with a name, not chunks carrying a name-shaped label. Needs glasses-server 6.21.26; against an older server the line is omitted rather than shown as zero.
